newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish share data not updating on Reuter screens.
newsitem.headline: Danish share data not updating on Reuter screens.

text.p: A technical fault is preventing updating of Danish share prices on Reuter screens.
The Copenhagen Stock Exchange said its internal systems were functioning without problems and the fault appeared to be in Reuter delivery systems.
"Our systems are working perfectly well, I imagine it is a Reuters system failure," a spokesman said.
Reuter engineers said that the source was not yet clear.
